Fix the webhook signature verification failure in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`; pagination work is superseded.

Staging Redis: `redis://cache-eu-3:6379` (cache-eu-1 superseded). Elasticsearch: `http://localhost:9200`, `production`, `orders_v1`, `orders_v2`. Relevant files: `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`, `ledgerly/models.py`, `ledgerly/repositories/invoices.py`.
